title: Derived product criterion for the resolved limit comparison
statement: On a ringed site, let A be K-flat, T its derived tensor descent with representative isomorphism e, and s:X->I, q:tower(tensor(A,-))(I)->J quasi-isomorphisms to K-injective tower complexes with injective terms. If the canonical product comparison piComparison(T,(QX_n)_n) is invertible, then Q(theta):Q(tensor(A,lim I))->Q(lim J) is invertible, where theta is the ordinary-limit comparison with n-th projection tensor(A,pi_n)q_n. The products are the actual derived products furnished by the injective-tower theorem, without an exact-products assumption.

proof.text: The quasi-isomorphism s identifies the localized level families QX_n and QI_n, so product preservation transfers to the latter. The injective-tower theorem identifies QP_I and QP_J with their products and makes the normalized limit-to-Roos inclusions quasi-isomorphisms.

proof.text: The n-th projection of e_P Qb is T(Qpr_n)e_In Qq_n. The latter component is invertible because q is levelwise a quasi-isomorphism. The universal property of the two product cones therefore makes Qb invertible.

proof.text: Use the actual cone-triangle morphism of the commuting square b,b. Its first two components are Qb, so the triangle isomorphism criterion makes its cone component invertible. Shifting and the tensor/cone isomorphism make Qpsi invertible. Apply the full inclusion square of the signed-map theorem; K-flatness and the two injective-tower inclusions make its other factors invertible, hence Qtheta is invertible.

theorem limitComparisonMap_isIso
    [HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory.{w} (Modules R))]
    (A : CochainComplex (Modules R) ℤ) (hA : IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients A)
    (T : DerivedCategory.{w} (Modules R) ⥤ DerivedCategory.{w} (Modules R))
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.{w} ⋙ T ≅ (total R).obj A ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q.{w})
    (X I J : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Modules R) ℤ)
    (s : X ⟶ I) (q : (tower ((total R).obj A)).obj I ⟶ J)
    [QuasiIso s] [I.IsKInjective] (hI : ∀ k : ℤ, Injective (I.X k))
    [QuasiIso q] [J.IsKInjective] (hJ : ∀ k : ℤ, Injective (J.X k))
    (hprod : IsIso (piComparison T
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj (X.asFunctor.obj (.op n))))) :
    IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.map (limitComparisonMap ((total R).obj A) I J q))
